english.title: Trader fail to provide consumer with a copy of regulated contract before conclusion
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader who had entered into a regulated contract with a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONSUMER..), failed to provide

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

with a copy of it at the time the contract was concluded
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(3) and (4) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
